spellbook.finance/limitations: Only the fixed Limitless standings endpoint is used. The tool accepts no arbitrary URL, credential or uploaded source.
Workspace ownership is checked before the write. A member or admin is refused.
The import is idempotent by customer and retry key. Reuse the same key and request after a timeout; do not invent a second key until the first claim is resolved.
Unmatched cards remain draft evidence with missingFields. They are not silently converted into owned catalog cards.

description: Import one player's Pokemon decklist from one fixed Limitless tournament standings record into the seller's workspace. The workspace owner chooses the event, player, format and idempotency key; retries with the same key replay the first result or report an in-progress import. The tool does not accept URLs or credentials and returns source identity, matched and unmatched counts, and the imported deck.

eventId.description: The Limitless tournament event id. Required.

idempotencyKey.description: A caller-generated retry key. Reuse it unchanged after an uncertain result. Required.

playerId.description: The exact player name or id as shown by the selected event. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to import into. The caller must be its owner. Required.

name: spellbook_deck_import_limitless
